Rice.soil_pref: Clayey, heavy alluvial soil with standing water tolerance.

Maize.soil_pref: Well-drained deep loamy soil rich in organic matter.

Chickpea.soil_pref: Sandy loam to clay loam, drought resistant.

Kidneybeans.soil_pref: Light well-drained loams, sensitive to waterlogging.

Pigeonpeas.soil_pref: Deep permeable loams, deep taproot system.

Mothbeans.soil_pref: Light sandy to loamy soils, highly drought resilient.

Mungbean.soil_pref: Loam to sandy loam with good internal drainage.

Blackgram.soil_pref: Heavy clay loam or black cotton soil.

Lentil.soil_pref: Alluvial, light loams to moderate clay soils.

Pomegranate.soil_pref: Deep loamy to gravelly soil with pH 6.0-7.5.

Banana.soil_pref: Rich fertile alluvial loam with high potassium.

Mango.soil_pref: Deep alluvial and red loamy soil, good drainage.

Grapes.soil_pref: Well-drained gravelly loam, sensitive to salinity.

Watermelon.soil_pref: Sandy loam, warms quickly in sunlight.

Muskmelon.soil_pref: Sandy to sandy loam, neutral to slightly alkaline.

Apple.soil_pref: Deep well-drained loam with chill requirement.

Orange.soil_pref: Light loamy to medium textured soil, no hardpan.

Papaya.soil_pref: Rich porous loam, zero tolerance for standing water.

Coconut.soil_pref: Coastal sandy loams, alluvial and red loams.

Cotton.soil_pref: Deep black cotton soil (Vertisols) with moisture retention.

Jute.soil_pref: Rich alluvial silt deposits along river basins.

Coffee.soil_pref: Fertile volcanic or humus-rich loam on slope terrain.
